LOW POLY BIRDS - ASSET LICENSE
Copyright (c) 2026 Soltorch Games Inc.

These birds were modelled and animated by hand for the game Look to the
Birds. Here are the terms in plain language so you can get on with using
them.


WHAT YOU CAN DO

Use the models, textures, animations and source files in any project,
personal or commercial. No royalties, no revenue cap.

Use them in as many of your own projects as you like. One purchase covers
you forever, not one game.

Modify anything. Remesh, retexture, re-rig, retarget, add or delete
animations, recolour, cut them up, combine them with other assets.

Use renders or gameplay footage containing them in your marketing, trailers,
screenshots and store pages.

Use them in games, films, animation, VR and AR, architectural work,
education, research, or anything else you think of.

You do not have to credit me. If you want to, "Birds by Soltorch Games" is
plenty. I would enjoy hearing what you made with them, but that is not
required either.


WHAT YOU CANNOT DO

Do not resell, redistribute, sublicense or give away the assets themselves,
modified or not, as assets. Not in another asset pack, not on another asset
store, not in a template or starter kit whose substance is the assets, not
as free downloads, not as an NFT or similar token.

Sell or share what you make with them, not the birds themselves. Shipping
them inside a game, film or app is fine, because that is a product. Shipping
them as files for other people to build with is not.

Do not use them to train generative machine learning models, or include them
in a dataset meant for that.

Do not claim you made the original assets.


IF YOU WORK WITH OTHER PEOPLE

One purchase covers you and anyone working directly on your project, whether
they are collaborators, contractors or employees. They may use the assets on
that project. If your studio wants them available to everyone across
unrelated projects, please buy a copy per seat or get in touch.

You can pass the files to a contractor working on your project. They may not
keep them for other clients afterwards.


NO WARRANTY

These assets are provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or
implied, including but not limited to the warranties of merchantability,
fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. In no event shall the
author be liable for any claim, damages or other liability arising from, out
of, or in connection with the assets or their use.


QUESTIONS

If something here is unclear, or your situation is not covered, just ask:

  https://soltorchgames.itch.io/

Asking is easier for both of us than guessing.
